consequences: Each release attaches Disk-Usage.dmg under that exact name. The first make dmg on a machine asks to let the terminal control Finder.
context: Releases were a versioned zip that users unzipped, dragged to Applications and then cleared the quarantine flag on in Terminal.
decision: make dmg builds dist-release/Disk-Usage.dmg with tools/dmg/ (Finder-laid-out window: app, arrow, Applications, background rendered from background.html). The name carries no version so the README can link to releases/latest/download/Disk-Usage.dmg. make release-zip is removed; the README tells users to use Open Anyway, with xattr as the alternative.
title: Ship the app as a DMG installer instead of a zip
